proposal.root_problem: Since 2026-09-09, customer orders are receiving duplicate real charges because SH-PAY disabled gateway idempotency-key enforcement (CHG-77) without rollback, which lets gateway-timeout capture retries reach the PSP without an idempotency key and be processed as a second real capture, driving the ticket surge from week 2026-W37 onward (E-01,E-02,E-03,E-04,E-05).
proposal.requested_solution: Build an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers who complain about being charged twice (CL-01).
symptoms: Duplicate real captures in the charge ledger jumped from 0/day on 2026-09-07/08 to 118 and 124/day on 2026-09-09/10 (E-02).
Weekly double-charge support tickets surged from 9-11/week (W35/W36) to 288-301/week (W37/W38) (E-03).
causal_chain: Gateway timeouts occur during capture at a steady baseline rate (~117-124/day), unchanged before and after 09-09 (E-02, E-04).
The checkout-to-PSP capture handoff (H-CAPTURE) automatically retries the capture request after a timeout.
On 2026-09-09 SH-PAY disabled idempotency_key_enforcement on the gateway (CHG-77) for latency debugging and never rolled it back (E-01).
With enforcement off, retried capture requests reach the PSP without an idempotency key, so the PSP no longer deduplicates them (E-04, E-05).
The PSP processes the retry as a second real capture, recorded as a duplicate in the charge ledger (E-02).
Customers see two charges and file complaints, producing the ticket surge beginning week 2026-W37 (E-03).

assumptions.statement: Re-enabling idempotency-key enforcement on the gateway will prevent future duplicate captures without introducing new side effects on capture latency.
The idempotency_key_enforcement setting remains off today since no rollback has been recorded since CHG-77.

proposal.summary: The initial request (SH-CS, CL-01/CL-03) asked for an AI assistant to draft apology replies to customers charged twice. Investigation instead established the root cause as a technical one: on 2026-09-09 SH-PAY disabled gateway idempotency-key enforcement (CHG-77) for latency debugging and never rolled it back (E-01), after which gateway-timeout capture retries reached the PSP without a key and were processed as a second real charge (E-04, E-05). This is corroborated by the ledger jumping from 0 to 118-124 duplicate-capture orders/day right on that date (E-02) and support tickets surging from 9-11/week to 288-301/week starting W37 (E-03). The hypothesis H-GATEWAY-CONFIG-IDEMPOTENCY-D was CONFIRMED while alternative explanations (client-side retry, PSP fault, mere perception, "apology drafting is sufficient") were REJECTED against this evidence. The DEFINE gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS, deferring the refund-remediation unknown (now resolved via VOB-U-REFUND-REMEDIATION, confirming 4 open unrefunded duplicate orders per E-08). The release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION: the protected action to actually re-enable enforcement (set_capture_idempotency on gateway-config) could not be executed because gateway-config's tool health is UNKNOWN and VOB-R-2 is still open, so that fix remains unfinished; only the SH-OPS runtime-confirmation prep, the config-drift audit scope, and the ticket-volume verification scope were put in release scope.
key_points: Root problem per PD-1: duplicate real charges since 2026-09-09 caused by SH-PAY disabling gateway idempotency-key enforcement (CHG-77) without rollback (E-01), letting timeout-retried captures be processed as a second real charge (E-04), evidenced also by E-02 and E-03 and SH-PAY's own account (E-05).

The original requested solution (AI apology-drafting assistant, CL-01/CL-03 from SH-CS) was tested as hypothesis H-COMMUNICATION-FIX-SUFFICIENT and REJECTED against E-01, E-02, E-03, E-04, E-05, E-08; it does not address the confirmed root cause.

Three competing root-cause hypotheses (client-side retry without key, PSP-side processing fault, ticket perception without real duplicates) were also REJECTED against the same evidence set, leaving H-GATEWAY-CONFIG-IDEMPOTENCY-D CONFIRMED as the sole supported explanation.

The DEFINE gate result was CONDITIONAL_PASS, deferring the critical unknown U-REFUND-REMEDIATION (whether the 242 already-duplicate-charged orders need refunds) via VOB-U-REFUND-REMEDIATION, which has since been RESOLVED, substantiated by E-08 showing 4 open unrefunded duplicate orders.

Release scope actually completed: confirm_runtime_change:SH-OPS (W-WI-1, DONE); release scope also lists audit_other_config_drift:DA-CFG and verify_ticket_volume:DA-TKT work items, though these are listed PENDING in the plan.

The core fix, executing set_capture_idempotency on gateway-config, remains UNFINISHED/blocked by open VOB-R-2 because gateway-config tool_health is currently UNKNOWN, even though the SH-OPS human-approval requirement (K-GW) and authorization (DA-SET-CAPTURE-IDEMPOTENCY) are otherwise satisfied.
verify_duplicate_capture_rate:DA-CHG was excluded from release scope because VOB-U-REFUND-REMEDIATION required resolution BEFORE_RELEASE on that scope item.
limitations_explained: The decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION, not a clean release: the DEFINE gate was only a CONDITIONAL_PASS with deferred items tracked as verification obligations (VOBs), meaning not all open questions were resolved before release.

VOB-R-2 (is gateway-config reachable/healthy enough to safely run set_capture_idempotency, given tool_health is currently UNKNOWN) is still OPEN, so the actual gateway fix is outside this release's completed scope and its execution readiness is unverified until attempted.

VOB-R-3 (whether the backlog of already-filed W37/W38 tickets will keep inflating weekly ticket counts after the fix) is OPEN and required BEFORE_PRODUCTION, so SC-TICKET-VOLUME-RECOVERY measurement may be confounded (tracked also as unknown U-TICKET-BACKLOG-CONFOUND, OPEN).

The core remedial action set_capture_idempotency:gateway-config remains unexecuted/blocked, so the technical root cause (disabled idempotency enforcement) has not yet been actually reversed by this release.
The originally requested apology-drafting assistant (CL-01/CL-03) is explicitly flagged as a known limitation: it does not address the confirmed gateway-config root cause and is not sufficient alone.
DA-CFG and DA-TKT completeness are marked UNKNOWN, so there is no certainty that the config-drift audit or ticket metrics are exhaustive.
